title: add curation assistant and model variant snapshotter
author: Aisha Kaur
release_notes: Introduces a Curation Assistant that drafts contextual changelog snippets from evaluation deltas and telemetry signals, plus a Variant Snapshotter that records a deterministic snapshot of model metadata, perf profiles, and sample outputs. Enables curator-in-the-loop release note approval and reproducible variant rollbacks.
description:
Motivation: model onboarding churn and noisy release notes delay rollouts. This PR adds two complementary tools: (1) a Curation Assistant that synthesizes candidate changelog bullets from structured eval deltas, telemetry counters, and sampled failing prompts; and (2) a Model Variant Snapshotter that captures a hashed metadata+profile bundle (model weights tag, quantization profile, perf histogram, representative sample set) to allow deterministic rollbacks and compact release diffs.

What this PR does: single-string summary + checklist. Key behavior: the assistant runs during the onboard pipeline and produces draft bullets that are surfaced in the registry UI and CLI for curator approval; draft bullets are annotated with signal provenance and suggested severity tags. The snapshotter produces small gzipped manifests stored in S3-compatible storage and a local index entry (no external DB schema changes). Snapshots are referenced in release notes and used by the changelog synth to produce delta context.

Checklist:
- [x] core snapshotter binary and storage integration (s3 client with retry/backoff)
- [x] curation assistant rule engine and delta extractor (eval + telemetry)
- [x] UI components to review/edit drafted bullets (VariantSnapshotEditor)
- [x] CLI export/import for snapshots (cli snapshot export/import)
- [x] unit + integration tests for serializer and recovery path
- [x] added telemetry events for curator actions and snapshot creation
- [x] documentation pages and usage examples
- [x] Linear tickets linked and changelog generation included in release flow

Commits: ["add: variant snapshotter core + manifest serializer", "feat: curation assistant delta extractor and scoring", "ui: variant snapshot editor and review flow", "cli: snapshot export/import and changelog preview", "test: add end-to-end snapshot recovery tests"].

Changed areas (high-level): ["src/curation/assistant.py", "src/snapshot/snapshotter.py", "cli/snapshot_cli.py", "webapp/components/VariantSnapshotEditor.tsx", "docs/curation-assistant.md", "infra/telemetry-schema.yaml", "scripts/generate_changelog.py", "tests/test_snapshot_end_to_end.py"].

Review conversation (summary): Reviewer Miguel: "Nice focused change; can we make sure snapshots remain small for large models? request: add compressed size limit and quota enforcement in uploader." Author (Aisha): "Added quota enforcement (default 10MB gzipped) and uploader rejects > limit with a clear error and suggestion to sample fewer exemplars. See snapshotter.upload() change." Reviewer Renee: "Curator UX looks good; please wire the approval event to telemetry so we can measure time-to-approve. Also ensure drafts are editable without changing provenance tags." Author: "Telemetry event added (curation.assist.approve/reject/edit). Drafts keep provenance metadata in an immutable field; editors only modify the human-facing summary." Reviewer Luca: "Tests flaked once on CI (S3 emulator timeout). Please add retry and a small fixture to avoid emulator flakiness." Author: "Added exponential backoff in tests and a local fixed-sample fixture; reran CI." CI: initial run had one flaky failure; rerun passed. Final status: all checks green.

Edge cases and migration notes: Snapshots are written to object store; existing registry records get a null snapshot reference by default. Backward compatibility: changelog synth falls back to previous heuristics if no snapshot is present. No DB schema migration required. There is an optional garbage-collection job (not part of this PR) to prune old snapshots.

Security/Privacy: exemplar samples are redacted using existing PII scrubber before snapshotting; KMS is used for signing snapshot manifest (optional via config).

Operational notes: default snapshot upload quota and retention policy can be overridden per-tenant via registry-config. Snapshots are immutable; a new snapshot must be created for each onboard attempt.

Outcome: approved by reviewers and merged via squash. Linear ENG-1023 marked done.
